description: This file defines an interface and a template class for hash stream processing within the Thunder::Crypto namespace. It includes external dependencies on HMAC, Hash, and Module headers, and provides abstractions for hash algorithms and streaming data for cryptographic purposes.

classes.name: IHashStream
classes.description: An interface for hash stream operations, including methods for retrieving hash type, resetting, obtaining result, getting length, and inputting data.

classes.name: HashStreamType
classes.description: A template class implementing hash streaming functionality for a specific hash algorithm and hash type, supporting both hash and HMAC streaming.

methods.name: HashStreamType(const Core::TextFragment& key)
methods.description: Constructor for HMAC streaming with a key.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the result of the hash computation.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the hash output.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Inputs data into the hash stream.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of hash algorithm used.
